title: Claim List
description: DISCOVER-stage typed artifact. Output of claim-extractor. An ordered list of atomic claims extracted from literature, each anchored to a source reference. Every claim requires non-empty text and a non-empty source_ref — a claim without a source cannot be verified.

source_scope.description: the query string or source set these claims were extracted from

claim_id.description: unique stable id within this list, e.g. c1, c2

source_ref.description: ref of the source making this claim (must be non-empty)
